acceptance.bounded_pending: queue-length + byte-cap backpressure, whole-event rejection, payload/connection caps
acceptance.close_facts: local_close/remote_close independent; terminal only when both closed, either order; drops counted on completing receipt + facts
acceptance.dropped_events: queued-at-terminal counted in dropped_events/dropped_bytes; post-terminal poll rejects; zero-drop negative
acceptance.forged_remote_close: second delivery rejects, post-terminal rejects, post-remote-close events reject; single genuine observation kept
acceptance.independent_probe: empty poll -> null event; remote-first order terminal+drops(1/3); forged+post-terminal reject
acceptance.no_spontaneous_input: poll returns only delivered frames; remote close exists only after explicit delivery
acceptance.opcode_payload: 4 opcodes, empty payload legal, bad-opcode/payload negatives

controls.local_only: in-memory node:assert, small-constant loops; facts-inert pinned
controls.network: none: no sockets/timers; responses move via explicit typed calls

prior_checks: peer 14/14, http 17/17, core 12/12, all native-values pass (re-run during review)

review.aliasing: deliver copies caller array, poll shifts then copies again; no K22-class hole (code-read)
review.read: websocket.ts 557 lines fully; check density 77 assert-ish calls
